text:
Erin: Quick sync — prepping the Simplestack pricing updates for EU webinar next Tue. Need a final FAQ sweep + microcopy for the calculator and a final pass on tier names. Running a small A/B on CTA text and inbound routing. Who owns what?
Sam: I can own the calculator copy tests and analytics. Can someone drop the current copy link?
Erin: Here — https://airtable.mock/simpliestack-pricing-copy (working draft). Also we have the benchmark blurb from research but need to lock phrasing.
Ben: For tier names I have two axes: functional vs marketing. Option 1: "Starter / Growth / Enterprise". Option 2: "Essentials / Scale / Platform". Which reads better for EU SMBs?
Lucy: My vote = Essentials / Scale / Platform. Feels less salesy and translates cleaner for FR/DE. Will verify char count.
Mike_product: Product is fine with Essentials/Scale/Platform. Need to update the slab bullets to include estimated tokens/mo and concurrency guidance. Small note: add "typical latency" line for webinar slides.
Sam: Test plan idea: Variant A CTA = "Calculate my estimate"; Variant B CTA = "See your monthly cost". Track clicks -> trial starts and routing to MQL. Also change default usage assumption on the EU calculator from 100k -> 50k tokens so numbers feel more realistic for EU customers.
Erin: For inbound routing we want EU leads to hit the EU-SDR queue first; if estimated_commitment > 1k/mo then escalate to AE. @Olivia_ops can you handle UTMs + routing rules?
Olivia_ops: Yep — I can add the UTM mapping. Proposed params: utm_campaign=simpliestack_pricing, utm_variant=A|B, utm_region=EU. Will also add routing rule: if utm_region==EU and estimated_cost>1000 -> AE-EU.
Legal_bot: Quick flag: any public-facing numbers in the FAQ or benchmark blurb should be qualified (e.g., "typical savings on common prompts"), and include GDPR/data-retention line for EU. Send final copy to legal for a 24h review.
Ben: Can someone draft the micro-FAQ changes? Minimal Qs: "How are overages billed?" "Can I reserve dedicated capacity?" Keep answers <=2 lines. I can polish after draft.
Lucy: I'll draft the FAQ + short answers and post here EOD. Also will include FR/DE translation notes (char limits).
Erin: Research benchmark blurb (needs copy polish): "Redwood delivers 3–5x lower per-token cost on common text generation workloads vs default configs, while maintaining latency under our SLOs." Ping @Mike_product for perf confirmation.
Mike_product: Numbers look right from our latest bench but we'll add confidence interval: "~3–5x" and include hardware spec footnote for the slide.
Sam: I'll wire the experiment in Optimizely and set goals: CTA clicks, click-to-MQL, webinar signups, and trial starts. Segment for returning users and for >10k token/month traffic. Sam: Also will add event mapping for utm_variant so we can compare variant performance.
Erin: Small config snippet for the calculator defaults to update (putting in repo after copy lock):
```
defaults = {
  "region": "EU",
  "avg_monthly_tokens": 50000,
  "concurrency": 4
}
```
Sam: noted and will update the experiment payload to reflect those defaults.
Olivia_ops: Routing checklist: UTMs, queue mapping, AE escalation threshold, and add an annotation in SFDC mapping for variant. I'll schedule the deploy for Wed AM.
Ben: Low-lift idea: A/B test tier label colors (CTA adjacent) — just CSS swaps. Could be a micro-conversion win.
Erin: Good call. Low risk. Add as a secondary test if Optimizely capacity allows.
Erin: Quick final checklist for clarity: copy (Lucy), legal review (Legal_bot), ops UTMs + routing (Olivia_ops), product perf copy (Mike_product), experiment setup (Sam), bench blurb confirmation (Mike_product). Lucy drop the draft here when ready. Thanks everyone :rocket:
